scope: Continued transparent-desktop usability development; not complete product acceptance.

regression.scope: Before final acceptance-only failure screenshot/log addition; exact final EXE receives focused native verification.

idle_avoidance.scope: Hidden stopped-timer real controller/private archives, segment clearance/3 scales/negative screens/long dt/occupied destination/release/monotonic wall escape/speed/bounds/randomness/legacy/protected states; no natural-time claim.

consent_feedback.scope: No-window setters/view plus private faulted consent files; no observer, real maintenance, business archive writes or native failure-dialog layout claim.

limitations: Escape is conservative. If screen edges leave no non-deepening exit, idle actors wait until the hero moves. Arbitrarily small screens and dense actual melee are not universally overlap-free.

Pending revocation followed by re-enable retains the existing permission state machine: the grant may be temporarily true until the queued revocation retry. This patch keeps its pending UI visible and does not redesign consent semantics.
Final x1 feature run starts from an explicit seeded qishi-full fixture and performs same-process Load, not natural growth or genuine new-process restoration.

Native Windows title bars/controls still need further visual polish; dynamic display-disconnection recovery, material-purpose guidance, mixed DPI and lock-screen handling remain to be improved or verified.
Performance samples cover about 21 seconds with capture overhead; long testing and automation-3 remain paused by the user. No natural first-harvest or eight-hour conclusion.
